content: मागध {%a.%} (-धी|{%f.%}) [मगधदेशे भवः अण्] Relating to or living in the country of Magadha or the people of Magadha. .{@-धः@} .²1 A king of the Magadhas. .²2 <ab>N.</ab> of a mixed tribe, said to have been the offspring of a Vaiśya father and a Kṣatriya mother, (the duty of the members of this caste being that of professional bards); <ls>Ms. 10. 11</ls>, <ls n="Ms. 10.">17</ls>; क्षत्रिया मागधं वैश्यात् <ls>Y. 1. 94</ls>; <ls>Mb. 13. 49. 10</ls>. .²3 A bard or panegyrist in general; सूतमागधवन्दिनः <ls>Bhāg. 1. 11. 20</ls>; परिणतिमिति रात्रेर्मागधा माधवाय <ls>Śi. 11. 1</ls>. .{@-धाः@} (<ab>pl.</ab>) <ab>N.</ab> of a people, the Magadhas. .{@-धा@} .²1 A princess of the Magadhas. .²2 Long pepper. .{@-धी@} .²1 A princess of the Magadhas; तयोर्जगृहतुः पादान् राजा राज्ञी च मागधी <ls>R. 1. 57</ls>. .²2 The language of the Magadhas, one of the four principal kinds of Prākṛta. .²3 Long pepper. .²4 White cumin. .²5 Refined sugar. .²6 A kind of jasmine. .²7 A variety of cardamoms. .²8 The daughter of a Kṣatriya mother and a Vaiśya father. .²9 Anise. .²10 <ab>N.</ab> of a river (शोणा). .²11 A kind of रीति in rhetorics. The अलङ्कारशेखर (7) gives the following illustration:-- पाणौ पद्मधिया मधूककुसुमभ्रान्त्या पुनर्गण्डयोर्नीलेन्दीवरशङ्कया नयनयोर्बन्धूकबुद्ध्याधरे . लीयन्ते कबरीषु बान्धवजनव्यामोहजातस्पृहा दुर्वारा मधुपाः क्रियन्ति तरुणि स्थानानि रक्षिष्यसि ..
